name: codex-harness
description: Harness by Moo: intent-gated role harness for Codex development.

interface.shortDescription: Intent-gated role harness for Codex development.
interface.longDescription: Harness by Moo is an opt-in development harness for Codex. It routes work through CEO requirements discovery, CTO architecture planning, CEO plan challenge, CTO response, implementation, verification, correctness/systems/design-pattern reviews, CTO recommendation triage, and final CEO intent check before the user briefing. The workflow is report-gated with hook guardrails for phase order, required artifacts, verdicts, and declined-review rationale.
